title: Lecturer on Developmental Biology, Part Time
bio: Dr. Leon Klempner completed his orthodontic specialty training at Tufts University and received his Doctorate degree from the University of Maryland. After graduation, he became a diplomate of the American Board of Orthodontics and practiced clinical orthodontics in private practice for 38 years. He has published articles in the American Journal of Orthodontics , Journal of Clinical Orthodontics , and numerous trade journals on the topics of early Class lll treatment and orthodontic marketing. In addition to teaching the Harvard orthodontic residents, he serves as the director of orthodontics and the cleft palate/craniofacial orthodontist for the Mount Sinai Hospitals in NY. He also holds an appointment in the department of Global Health at the Icahn School of Medicine. Dr. Klempner is the founder of the Smile Rescue Fund for Kids, a nonprofit charity focused on helping children in Africa.
